      "category": "dead code",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 1743,
      "message": "The `skip_restore=false` restore-and-put_back branch inside `_runner_from_stage_preflight` is unreachable from `main()`: the guard `if [[ -n \"$from_stage\" ]] && ! $resume_mode` at line 2313 returns 1 before the preflight call whenever `resume_mode=false`, and the preflight is called at line 3100 with `\"$resume_mode\"` as `skip_restore`, which is always `true` when `from_stage` is set, so the git-restore step (lines 1746–1754) never executes.",
      "quote": "    if ! $_fsp_skip_restore; then\n        # Restore + put_back (same sequence as _runner_resume_rehydrate). Skipped\n        # when already restored by _runner_resume_rehydrate (resume + from-stage).\n        local _fsp_staging=\"$_fsp_state_dir/from-stage-preflight.staging\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {

      "severity": "low",

      "message": "The header comment references `ADR-006 §3.5`, but the step being tested (`_runner_from_stage_preflight`, added for `--from-stage` rehydration) is `§3.6` — the new step introduced by this PR.",
      "quote": "# (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5 / _runner_from_stage_preflight)",

    },

      "quote": "# Tests: all three resume entry paths invoke _runner_resume_rehydrate before\n# the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)",

    }
